communicates ideas, concepts and processes for textile design and production

L1.1.heading: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ textile Practices
L1.1.text: Identify textile art forms created for expression, communication and Storytelling

L1.2.heading: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ textile Practices
L1.2.text: Describe Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander textile designer Practices and products
L1.2.example: Aboriginal fashion designer couture, activewear, sporting apparel, textile installations in art and design contexts.

L1.3.heading: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ textile Practices
L1.3.text: Explore Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ material sourcing Practices and describe the suitability of the materials for end use
L1.3.example: Wetland grasses and reeds, pandanus as a waterproof material, spinifex cultivation for basket weaving, bark fibre for string, mats, dilly bags and dance belts.

L1.4.heading: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ textile Practices
L1.4.text: Investigate Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander customary Practices and outline how they are applied to contemporary designs
L1.4.example: Piinpi fashion, Aboriginal textile designers, symbolism in representative sports jerseys.

L1.5.heading: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ textile Practices
L1.5.text: Evaluate ethical considerations for the use and appropriation of designs and products

L1.6.heading: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ textile Practices
L1.6.text: Explore design inspiration sources in the local area to generate textile design ideas and concepts

L1.7.heading: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ textile Practices
L1.7.text: Apply protocols for designing with respect for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander designers, Communities and Cultural Knowledges, including Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property (ICIP)

L2.1.heading: Historical and cultural influences on textile practices
L2.1.text: Investigate textile designers and textile products from a range of historical periods

L2.2.heading: Historical and cultural influences on textile practices
L2.2.text: Identify and describe how historical design features can be applied to contemporary designs

L2.3.heading: Historical and cultural influences on textile practices
L2.3.text: Investigate reasons textile design practices have changed over time

L2.4.heading: Historical and cultural influences on textile practices
L2.4.text: Evaluate how textile practices have changed over time to improve sustainability

L2.5.heading: Historical and cultural influences on textile practices
L2.5.text: Investigate and evaluate textile practices and describe design features of textile products from a range of cultural groups

L2.6.heading: Historical and cultural influences on textile practices
L2.6.text: Evaluate how diverse cultural perspectives may influence the work of textile designers

L2.7.heading: Historical and cultural influences on textile practices
L2.7.text: Identify historical and cultural design features to apply as sources of design inspiration in the development of textile projects

L3.1.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.1.text: Identify fibres cultivated in Australia for use in textile design and production

L3.2.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.2.text: Describe local and global techniques used in the cultivation and processing of fibres

L3.3.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.3.text: Identify and evaluate sustainable textile materials and practices
L3.3.example: Organic and vegan textiles, organic and chemical-free farming.

L3.4.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.4.text: Identify textile supply chain systems to assess future development opportunities

L3.5.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.5.text: Explain current challenges that may influence future development of Australian textile industries
L3.5.example: Climate, pest and disease management, market fluctuations, textile imports.

L3.6.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.6.text: Discuss emerging opportunities to improve sustainable textile practices
L3.6.example: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO) sustainably produced fibres, waste management processes.

L3.7.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.7.text: Investigate innovative technologies used in textile design and production

L3.8.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.8.text: Investigate career opportunities in textile design and production industries

L3.9.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.9.text: Describe the influence of globalisation on the Australian textile industry

L3.10.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.10.text: Analyse ethical considerations for local and global textile design and production practices

L3.11.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.11.text: Investigate community and industry initiatives that promote textile sustainability and consumer awareness

L3.12.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.12.text: Explore ways designers and consumers can influence change in textile design and production practices to improve sustainability in the textile industry

L3.13.heading: Textile industry design and production practices
L3.13.text: Explain relationships between textile design, production and sustainable practices

D1.1.heading: Textile design for diverse purposes
D1.1.text: Identify and describe different purposes of textile design

D1.2.heading: Textile design for diverse purposes
D1.2.text: Investigate how textile designers adapt designs in response to consumer demands

D1.3.heading: Textile design for diverse purposes
D1.3.text: Evaluate adaptive, emerging and innovative textile technologies for specific purposes
D1.3.example: Light-up safety wear, sensory-friendly clothing, temperature control clothing.

D1.4.heading: Textile design for diverse purposes
D1.4.text: Describe how innovative textile design can improve accessibility, participation and inclusivity for diverse populations

D1.5.heading: Textile design for diverse purposes
D1.5.text: Assess the functional requirements of textile products for their intended purpose

D1.6.heading: Textile design for diverse purposes
D1.6.text: Generate textile ideas and concepts for identified needs and diverse purposes

D2.1.heading: Material selection for textile production and end use
D2.1.text: Identify a range of fibres, yarns and fabrics used in the creation of textile projects

D2.2.heading: Material selection for textile production and end use
D2.2.text: Outline differences between natural and synthetic fibre production

D2.3.heading: Material selection for textile production and end use
D2.3.text: Compare characteristics of yarn types, including staple and filament composition, single and plied structure, low and high twist, and other properties, including strength and texture

D2.4.heading: Material selection for textile production and end use
D2.4.text: Identify properties and structures of fabrics, including woven, knit and non-woven

D2.5.heading: Material selection for textile production and end use
D2.5.text: Explain how properties of fibres, yarns and fabrics determine their suitability for end use

D2.6.heading: Material selection for textile production and end use
D2.6.text: Evaluate sustainable material sourcing practices for textile design and production

D2.7.heading: Material selection for textile production and end use
D2.7.text: Explain the selection and suitability of materials for textile products

D3.1.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.1.text: Identify elements of design, including shape, size, colour, value, line, direction and texture

D3.2.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.2.text: Identify principles of design, including proportion, balance, rhythm, emphasis, contrast and harmony

D3.3.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.3.text: Describe elements and principles of design featured in works created by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples

D3.4.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.4.text: Assess how elements and principles of design feature in the works and collections of textile designers

D3.5.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.5.text: Explore customary and contemporary decorative design Practices developed by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples

D3.6.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.6.text: Investigate textile designs and designers that feature creative decorative applications

D3.7.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.7.text: Generate ideas and concepts for innovative design and technological applications

D3.8.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.8.text: Demonstrate safe and ethical practices when using digital design and technological applications

D3.9.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.9.text: Investigate the application of innovative sustainable technologies for textile design and production

D3.10.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.10.text: Explore elements and principles of design through practical application

D3.11.heading: Creative textile design and technological applications
D3.11.text: Evaluate the practices and products of textile designers

D4.1.heading: Promotion of textile products
D4.1.text: Identify and describe target markets for current and emerging textile designers and brands

D4.2.heading: Promotion of textile products
D4.2.text: Compare promotional strategies used by textile designers

D4.3.heading: Promotion of textile products
D4.3.text: Investigate how data is used by textile designers and brands to inform textile product design

D4.4.heading: Promotion of textile products
D4.4.text: Explain how textile designers promote ethical and sustainable design practices

D4.5.heading: Promotion of textile products
D4.5.text: Use digital design and technological applications to create promotional materials for textile consumers

D4.6.heading: Promotion of textile products
D4.6.text: Demonstrate safe and ethical practices when accessing and collecting data

P1.1.heading: Textile design areas
P1.1.text: Identify textile products created within a range of different textile design areas

P1.2.heading: Textile design areas
P1.2.text: Outline the uses of a range of textile products

P1.3.heading: Textile design areas
P1.3.text: Describe aesthetic features of a range of textile products

P1.4.heading: Textile design areas
P1.4.text: Explain functional properties of a range of textile products

P2.1.heading: Design inspiration
P2.1.text: Investigate a range of design inspiration sources

P2.2.heading: Design inspiration
P2.2.text: Explore how designers use design inspiration sources when developing textile products and collections

P2.3.heading: Design inspiration
P2.3.text: Select and evaluate design inspiration sources for the development of textile projects

P2.4.heading: Design inspiration
P2.4.text: Outline features of design inspiration sources used to generate and refine ideas

P2.5.heading: Design inspiration
P2.5.text: Demonstrate safe and ethical practices using digital technologies to source information

P3.1.heading: Idea development
P3.1.text: Explore design software and applications to design and generate ideas

P3.2.heading: Idea development
P3.2.text: Apply design and creative thinking to generate ideas using a range of communication techniques
P3.2.example: Fashion drawing, production drawings, pattern pieces, sketching.

P3.3.heading: Idea development
P3.3.text: Annotate aesthetic features and functional properties of design ideas

P3.4.heading: Idea development
P3.4.text: Evaluate and refine design ideas to justify the selection of final textile products using written, visual, verbal or multimodal communication forms

P3.5.heading: Idea development
P3.5.text: Analyse ways that textile ideas and products could be modified to improve sustainability

P3.6.heading: Idea development
P3.6.text: Use subject-specific terminology to communicate ideas for textile design and production

P4.1.heading: Experimentation
P4.1.text: Explore and experiment with construction techniques to test their suitability for textile products through practical application

P4.2.heading: Experimentation
P4.2.text: Investigate and experiment with decorative techniques to enhance textile products through practical application

P4.3.heading: Experimentation
P4.3.text: Evaluate experimentation with decorative and construction techniques to determine their application to textile projects

P4.4.heading: Experimentation
P4.4.text: Experiment with design software and applications to decorate and manipulate materials for textile design and production

P4.5.heading: Experimentation
P4.5.text: Examine fabric characteristics and properties to determine their suitability for textile products
P4.5.example: Abrasion resistance, breathability, colour, drape, durability, stretch, texture, woven, knitted, bonded, waterproof.

P4.6.heading: Experimentation
P4.6.text: Justify the selection of materials used for textile products through testing and evaluation

P4.7.heading: Experimentation
P4.7.text: Create written texts to describe and evaluate design ideas and production processes

P5.1.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.1.text: Apply planning and organisation skills in the production of textile products

P5.2.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.2.text: Demonstrate safe practices when selecting and using materials, technologies and processes

P5.3.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.3.text: Identify and apply appropriate standards and codes of practice when designing textile products
P5.3.example: Mandatory standards for safety testing and care labelling, diversity codes of practice.

P5.4.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.4.text: Use collaborative practices in textile design and production, including teamwork, communication and shared decision-making

P5.5.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.5.text: Deconstruct textile products to identify components and explore creative reuse opportunities

P5.6.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.6.text: Identify and apply sustainable practices and processes for textile design and production

P5.7.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.7.text: Identify and select appropriate fabric and notions for production

P5.8.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.8.text: Select, modify and use construction patterns
P5.8.example: Commercial patterns, drafting blocks, digital pattern making applications.

P5.9.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.9.text: Interpret pattern instructions, transfer pattern marking and apply pattern layout plans

P5.10.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.10.text: Select and apply construction techniques to develop quality textile products

P5.11.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.11.text: Select and apply decorative techniques to enhance textile designs
P5.11.example: Colouration, embellishment, fabric manipulation, haberdashery applications.

P5.12.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.12.text: Apply ongoing evaluation during the development and production of textile products

P5.13.heading: Textile product construction and design application
P5.13.text: Develop, refine and demonstrate technical proficiency through textile project work, individually or collaboratively
